MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #1
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Solve for x: x + 3 = 7. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 7
   C. 4
   D. 3

2. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 90
   C. 18
   D. 81

3. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 12x
   D. 6x + 2

4. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 24
   C. 5
   D. 25

5. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 65
   B. 16
   C. 64
   D. 0

6. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 1
   C. 5
   D. 7

7. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 144
   C. 156
   D. 24

8. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. Cannot tell
   C. They are equal
   D. 1/4

9. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.25
   B. 2.5
   C. 0.205
   D. 0.025

10. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 21
   C. 20
   D. 1

11. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 12
   C. 36
   D. 24

12. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 169
   C. 13
   D. 26

13. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 4

14. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 18
   C. 81
   D. 9

15. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 49
   C. 2
   D. 14

16. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 4

17. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15.6
   C. 15
   D. 15.7

18. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 37

19. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 9
   C. 10
   D. 40.5

20. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 5
   C. 37
   D. 36

21. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 2/3
   B. 3/4
   C. 1/2
   D. 1/4

22. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 25
   C. 2
   D. 1

23. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 22
   C. 28
   D. 14

24. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26

   C. 25
   D. 10

25. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)

26. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)

28. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)

30. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
